Bundled third-party source (licences: ../THIRD-PARTY.md)

JUCE 7.0.12 (JUCE/): official release, not modified for Kicktone. Includes the Steinberg
  VST3 SDK 3.7.8 under juce_audio_processors/format_types/VST3_SDK.
r8brain-free-src (r8brain/): unmodified core headers and FFT source from
  https://github.com/avaneev/r8brain-free-src (master archive retrieved
  2026-10-11), MIT licence. Provenance in r8brain/SOURCE.txt.
Toolchain-Licenses/LLVM.txt: licence of the LLVM-MinGW toolchain used only by
  the optional Linux cross-build (scripts/CrossBuild.py).
